317:t_1:86.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It seems the news is reporting it as a natural disaster.」

317:t_1:87.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Of course it is. If they said someone's device caused a $$時空震動$$, the public would be in an uproar.」

317:t_1:88.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They researched that technology in $$ＵＣＷ$$, but the chaos afterward and failed experiments brought it to a complete standstill.」

317:t_1:89.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「By contrast, $$アマルガム$$'s technological power in completing it is beyond imagination.」

317:t_1:90.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Deal with them later. First, take care of the $$黒い稲妻旅団$$.」

317:t_1:91.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's a grandiose name for a bandit gang.」

317:t_1:92.en:
$$バニラ$$
「They say they used to be a military unit. They're using the chaos of the Empire's dominance to do whatever they please.」

317:t_1:93.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We'll see for ourselves whether they deserve to call themselves black.」

317:t_1:94.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Their forces are mainly ATs, but they certainly have a lot of them.」

317:t_1:95.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A gang of outlaws exploiting the world's chaos hardly leaves room for negotiation.」

317:t_1:96.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Now, now... Put your negotiating skills to use somewhere else.」

317:t_1:97.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I suppose I must. Then I'll use them to negotiate our payment for this job.」

317:t_1:98.en:
$$バニラ$$
「W-wait...! That's not what I meant!」

317:t_1:99.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Well, don't worry. $$バニラ$$ and I are executives of $$グルフェー$$'s Chamber of Commerce.」

317:t_1:100.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「We don't intend to haggle your fee down more than necessary.」

317:t_1:101.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Those words, 'more than necessary'... ignite my negotiator's spirit.」

317:t_1:102.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Haha... I'm counting on you to go easy on us, $$ロジャー$$.」

317:t_1:103.en:
$$市民$$
「...$$ゴウト$$. Are these the guards you've hired?」

317:t_1:104.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Yes, that's right. They're acquaintances of mine, but their skills are beyond doubt.」

317:t_1:105.en:
$$市民$$
「You needn't ask people like that. Salvation will soon arrive from the Church...」

317:t_1:106.en:
$$バニラ$$
「...What, are you still whining about that?」

317:t_1:107.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「It can't be helped. We can't understand what those people are thinking.」

317:t_1:108.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Who was that person just now?」

317:t_1:109.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「A fellow executive of the $$グルフェー$$ Chamber of Commerce.」

317:t_1:110.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「And a believer in $$マーティアル$$, by the way.」

317:t_1:111.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A believer in $$マーティアル$$...」

317:t_1:117.en:
$n
「I'd pictured a much more crowded, shabby place...」

317:t_1:118.en:
$$ココナ$$
「$$グルフェー$$ is the information industry hub for this region. Lots of people here are what you'd call rich.」

317:t_1:119.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's why the bandits are targeting it...」

317:t_1:120.en:
$$ココナ$$
「But it'll be all right...! With $$キリコ$$ and you guys here, we've got nothing to worry about.」

317:t_1:121.en:
$n
「I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.」

317:t_1:122.en:
$$カレン$$
「With the world in such trouble, we can't leave people free to do whatever they please for their own desires.」

317:t_1:124.en:
$$カレン$$
「Of course I haven't. And neither has $$キリコ$$.」

317:t_1:128.en:
$$ココナ$$
「Those clothes... They're probably $$マーティアル$$ believers.」

317:t_1:129.en:
$$市民$$
「...Thus, the law of all things is harmony through conflict. Battle for the love of the universe, battle for its father and mother. Battle, battle, battle...」

317:t_1:131.en:
$$市民$$
「Let us seek God's path through battle. Through our $$マーティアル$$, through our $$マーティアル$$...」

317:t_1:133.en:
$$市民$$
「The $$秩序の盾$$ will come from $$アレギウム$$ and beat those bandits in no time.」

317:t_1:135.en:
$$市民$$
「It is. $$マーティアル$$ is strong.」

317:t_1:136.en:
$$市民$$
「'Martial force is true harmony,' you know.」

317:t_1:139.en:
$$市民$$
「I don't like it, somehow... being told to fight, fight...」

317:t_1:144.en:
$$キリコ$$
「...$$ココナ$$. Is what I asked $$ゴウト$$ for ready?」

317:t_1:145.en:
$$ココナ$$
「Oh... yes... I think it's ready.」

317:t_1:146.en:
$$ココナ$$
「They're custom parts for the $$スコープドッグ$$'s assault configuration... You'll be invincible with those.」

317:t_1:152.en:
$$キリコ$$
(...Battle, battle, battle... The child's voice kept repeating in my head...)

317:t_1:153.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Battle... It swallowed $$フィアナ$$ and me, and never let us escape...)

317:t_1:154.en:
$$キリコ$$
(A god that glorifies it... I couldn't bring myself to accept such a being...)

318:t_000:0.en:
$$ナミ$$
「How is it, $$宗介$$? I replaced the $$マッスルパッケージ|lc$$ with a better one, like you said.」

318:t_000:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's not bad. I can fight well enough with this.」

318:t_000:2.en:
$$レモン$$
「But I didn't expect you to custom-paint the AS when you had me buy paint...」

318:t_000:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I hear that's standard showmanship in arenas and $$バトリング$$.」

318:t_000:4.en:
$$ナミ$$
「《$$バトリング$$》...? You've piloted ATs, too?」

318:t_000:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's something I heard from an acquaintance.」

318:t_000:6.en:
$$ナミ$$
「But be careful. AT pilots compete in this arena, too, and the level is pretty high.」

318:t_000:7.en:
$$ナミ$$
「And real battles with firearms are standard here.」

318:t_000:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's no problem. I'm more used to that, anyway.」

318:t_000:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「And there's a $$メララ$$ $$ショット・キャノン|lc$$. It's reassuring to have familiar equipment.」

318:t_000:11.en:
$$ナミ$$
「You're... Japanese, right? I hear Japan's still fairly peaceful, even with the world like this...」

318:t_000:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「I see... I thought you had an unusual name for someone here...」

318:t_000:15.en:
$$宗介$$
(Maybe that's why... I thought $$ナミ$$ resembled $$千鳥$$ when I saw her...)

318:t_000:16.en:
$$ナミ$$
「So... what's with that color scheme?」
